Class TransitNetwork

java.lang.Object
rgu.transport.geospatial.multimodal.TransitNetwork
public final class TransitNetwork extends Object
A multi-modal transit network. TransitNetwork is thread-safe, however, the builder object is not thread-safe.
Author:
Lee A. Christie
